name: The Glass to the Ice Palace

hp.details: Broken Threshold 75 — the Queen's Rime ends when the Glass is Broken; the gloom lifts when it is Destroyed.

stealth.details: (0 to notice the Glass; the rime flares at the start of each round)

details.description: A towering mirror set high on the far wall in a frame of black ice. Through it, clear as a window, lies the frozen palace of Natalia, Queen of Shadows — and she stands within, watching down, impassive. While the Glass stands, frost creeps across the floor and walls, the Queen's power bleeding through the glass: the hall stays frozen and the floor slick with rime until the mirror cracks.
details.disable:
@Check[thievery|dc:38|name:Deface the Glass] (master) to score and craze the surface, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Dispel Magic] (7th rank, counteract DC 36) to sever the Queen's channel — or simply destroy the Glass. It is an object: Hardness 14 (halved to 7 against adamantine, whose standard-grade weapons match its Hardness), HP 150, Broken Threshold 75. It is mounted ~15 ft up the far wall — ranged adamantine attacks reach it from the floor; a melee weapon needs the wraparound gallery (up the half-collapsed stair) or a Climb up the frost-slick wall (Athletics, off-guard while climbing).

Broken (75 HP): the Queen's channel is severed and the rime melts at once — the cold and the difficult terrain end.

Destroyed (0 HP): the glass shatters, the plane's gloom lifts (light functions normally), and the gateway to the Ice Palace closes for good.
details.routine: (1 action) The Queen's Rime. Modeled on @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Frozen Fog]. At the start of each creature's turn, a creature within the rime (the emanation — all but the Glass and the Queen's allies) takes @Damage[6d8[cold]] damage with a basic @Check[fortitude|dc:38|basic] save. A creature that fails is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 1} (Clumsy 2 on a critical failure) and takes a −10-foot status penalty to its Speeds for as long as it is clumsy. The rimed floor is difficult terrain. The rime acts every round until the Glass is Broken.

description.value: While the Glass stands, the Queen of Shadows' power bleeds through it, sheathing the hall in creeping frost. Creatures caught in the emanation are coated in killing cold — resolve the damage in the hazard's routine.
